notes.title: Folklore Hunter 0.5e - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi guys, there were a few issues with the latest update brought to my attention so I have put together a small hotfix to address these problems.

Changelog

 Fixed spamming escape to skip the intro cause the game to soft-lock and never recover.
 Fixed aggression and pathfinding issues with the Wendigo introduced in the latest update.
 Fixed various bodies of water not rendering on lower graphics settings.

As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA I also occasionally stream live development over at https://www.twitch.tv/smirkstick. Come hang!

notes.title: Bloodfang Forest - Folklore Hunter Major Update
notes.notes:
The time has finally come for the next hunt in the Folklore Hunter series: Bloodfang Forest. The occupants of a small mountainous village have gone missing, find and kill whoever/whatever took them using a plethora of new items and abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36597407/87e00cb81b16cb8f62cfa0b24225a7bde46f9e1d.png

I would like to take this time to thank all of you for your patience over these last few months, there have been many challenges thrown my way and feel so lucky to have a community who understands and supports me and the game. This new hunt has been a huge undertaking, and I've taken extra time to align it with my vision of the hunt. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36597407/3a2eb782a4d84ffd217342504f0dfee95e525744.png

Note: This is only the beginning for Bloodfang Forest, there will be many more content updates to add more story, strategy and content to the hunt (as well as development of the wendigo hunt). I'm hoping to get back into more regular updates now that the bulk of the work has been completed on the new hunt.

There are way too many changes to list here so I've summarized the most noteworthy of the bunch below.

 BRAND NEW creature
 BRAND NEW map (4x larger than wendigo map)
 New "hunter senses" mode for tracking and visualizing audio (Hold Q)
 New items and tools
 AI improvements
 Performance tweaks
 New music and sound effects
 Many bugfixes and stability issues solved


As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA I also occasionally stream live development over at twitch.tv/smirkstick. Come hang!

<3 Smirk

notes.title: Folklore Hunter Update 0.3a
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Been a while since the last update, I've been hard at work as usual. Plenty of new content in this update as well as preparations for new content going forward. The feel of this version of the game is going to be a bit different than previous, I'd love to hear your thoughts.

Anyways, hope you are all coping okay during these trying times. Stay safe <3

Patch Notes:

 Wolves have been added to the game. They utilize a brand new AI system that allows them to roam the map in small packs. Keep your eye out.
 Completely remade first-person animations. (Idle, Walk, Sprint, Jump, Shoot. Reload)
 Added slight weapon sway when aiming.
 New explorable cave system.
 Wendigo is now persistent in the world and will no longer despawn at night time. 
 Added new ambient audio that only plays at night time.
 Added new soundscape for night time.
 Added the ability to split item stacks.
 Added Y-Axis inversion to options controls menu.
 Improved audio specialization of various sounds in the game, including wendigo calls.
 Fixed clients not being able to access cameras if they were placed by another player who isn't the host.
 Fixed damage FX being shown to all players, even if they didn't take any damage. (Often happens when someone steps in a bear trap)
 Added fallback code to help wendigo not get stuck as often.
 Collision pass on environmental objects.
 Added help text to inventory screen.
 Fixed various holes and glitches in map geometry.
 Altered locations of required items for the end sequence.
 General codebase restructure in preparation for new content.


As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA We also have a public Trello where you can track the development of the game here: https://trello.com/b/Bcrfkaba/folklore-hunter-public-trello

-Smirk

notes.title: Folklore Hunter Update 0.2b - Camera Rework
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update addresses some issues with the cameras and should make them much more useful. I have reworked the system from the ground up and you can now control & zoom the cameras with the mouse. They also have inbuilt motion detectors which will send you a notification when motion is detected. I have also reworked the minimap to allow for other markers to be shown so you can now see your friends in multiplayer, and also see placed cameras on the map.

Other than that, there are a lot of other gameplay fixes and tweaks including a temp fix for people having the DX crash issue. Another update will follow shortly so stay tuned!


Patch Notes:

 Removed video settings that were causing the DX crash for some people.
 Overhauled camera system
 New camera UI with better UX
 Cameras now have motion detectors and will give a notification if motion is detected.
 Cameras can now be rotated and zoomed.
 Decreased vision obfuscation on the camera view.
 Cameras now have more human-readable names and are synced properly in multiplayer.
 Cameras are now marked on the map.
 Added map markers for all players in multiplayer games.
 Fixed navigation issues when the map is altered. Navigation will now update at runtime if substantial environment changes are made.
 Rewrote crate & deer spawning to ensure they are always in reachable locations.
 Added player nametags in multiplayer. (WIP)
 Added secondary keybind for flashlight ('F')
 Raised battery life from 7.5 to 12.5 minutes.
 Fixed placed items will now drop to the ground if not properly supported.
 Fixed totems not rotating for clients.
 Fixed wendigo continuing to attack a player after they are already dead.


As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA We also have a public Trello where you can track the development of the game here: https://trello.com/b/Bcrfkaba/folklore-hunter-public-trello

-Smirk

notes.title: Folklore Hunter Update 0.2a - Let the Ritual Commence
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

This update has taken a little longer than previous updates due to the sheer amount of new content added. This update has been focused around the wendigo banishment ritual. I've also included a bunch of bug fixes, performance tweaks, and changes to make the game more stable. There is still more to do on the ritual, but this will be covered in a future update. Thank you for all the support and kind messages I have been receiving this last week! <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36597407/51666bd7fd6edd7a84ca03ada0e441e7aa5caf6b.png

Patch Notes:

 MAJOR CONTENT: Added wendigo banishment ritual, and associated items and content required to permanently defeat the wendigo.
 Improved placement system that disallows placing objects inside each other, and requires flat (ish) ground.
 You can now drop items from your inventory to other players.
 Added tooltip descriptions to all items.
 Added new hidden items and clues around the map.
 Wendigo now becomes more fearless as you progress through the game.
 Fixed a UI bug when a player picks up a camera you are viewing through.
 Fixed bug where you can swap items with items in the crafting grid.
 Fixed wendigo being able to access unfavorable locations via root motion animations played during attacks.
 Fixed issue where players were able to pick up each other's items when during placement. Objects will now only become visible to other players when finalizing placement.
 Fixed being able to view through a camera that hasn't been placed yet.
 Fixed various geometry issues related to river banks.
 Fixed various geometry issues in the caves.
 Added win sequence (Placeholder for in-game cinematic) when banishing the wendigo.


As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA We also have a public Trello where you can track the development of the game here: https://trello.com/b/Bcrfkaba/folklore-hunter-public-trello

-Smirk

notes.title: Folklore Hunter 0.1g - AI Update #1
notes.notes:
This update has come sooner than I had planned, therefore I've decided to split the AI update into multiple parts. This update includes the groundwork for the new AI system, as well as fixes for a few critical issues.

Patch notes:
- Fixed not being able to properly exit camera view.
- Wendigo now has hearing and smell senses along with sight.
- Wendigo now gets stuck in traps for slightly longer
- Fixed clients not receiving ammo from loot crates.
- Fixed wendigo teleporting into undesirable locations, in fact, removed teleport ability altogether.
- Fixed wendigo sometimes spawning inside geometry such as rocks, or even under the map.
- Fixed wendigo head tracking. No more peaking under his armpits at you!
- Fixed wendigo sometimes not spawning in multiplayer.
- Wendigo now disengages from fights to hide when the morning is approaching.
- Fixed various geometry issues in the map.
- Removed collision from meat.
- Fixed player being able to outrun all wendigo attacks.
- Wendigo now notices when the players are split up in multiplayer...
- General wendigo AI improvements.
- Reduced main menu music volume.

Known Issues:
- You can no longer pick up meat. This is NOT intended and will be addressed in the next update.

As always, thanks for the continued support. You can join our development discord server here: https://discord.gg/B9u6pUA We also have a public Trello where you can track the development of the game here: https://trello.com/b/Bcrfkaba/folklore-hunter-public-trello

notes.title: FolkloreHunter Update 0.1c - Bugfixes, Story & Map
notes.notes:
As always - Thank-you all for your continued support of Folklore Hunter! This has been a big week, we've been working hard on fixing many of the game-breaking issues that players have been reporting. We've also redesigned the main menu, and added a small taste of the story. You can read the full patch notes below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36597407/f53042ec80831a6e85f09372015226aacae123af.png

Patch Notes:

- New main menu redesign.
- Added story intro sequence.
- New hidden points of interest to discover.
- Ammo now spawns much more frequently from hidden caches.
- New "mirage" system.
- Reduced stun-lock when wendigo is damaged.
- Fixed areas of the map that were not fully enclosed allowing some players to fall off the map.
- Fixed an issue where you could run out of ammo by continually reloading your gun at full ammo.
- Fixed an issue where the game would try to boot with SteamVR for some players.

I'll be continuing to fix known issues and adding new content over the next week. If you haven't already please join the FolkloreHunter discord if you have any suggestions, bug reports, or feedback: Folklore Hunter Discord Server

Thanks again for supporting FolkloreHunter!
- Smirk

notes.title: FolkloreHunter Update 0.1b - Steam Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Thank-you all for your support over the last week! It has been great to get such positive feedback and i'm glad you are all enjoying the game. I have been hard at work implementing a steam multiplayer server browser in the last few days. This will replace the direct IP connection system, and should allow players to have an easier time playing with each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36597407/a27c3afbec2732306ad880c44ceec448848d1d53.jpg

Patch Notes

Added a new steam multiplayer server browser.
 Fixed an issue where the settings menu would not display from the main menu.


The next minor update will be within the next week and will focus on some of the other smaller issues that have been reported. If you haven't already please join the FolkloreHunter discord if you have any suggestions, bug reports, or feedback: Folklore Hunter Discord Server

Thanks again for supporting FolkloreHunter!
